entries.summary: The repo map gains an Atlas view drawn from the GhostAtlas tool's own scan (packages, per-file token estimates, importers, dead-code candidates, git activity), and chat gains Recall memory: GhostRecall ranks the project's decisions, notes and git history for the task in the chat box, with its estimated token costs and provenance, and the selected memory can be added to chat context as the tool's own bundle export. Both tools join the on-device bundle, and GhostHandoff's package joins it too (its E4 endpoint was already on the phone; the module now is as well).

Two chat actions: Prime this project builds a GhostPrimer starter bundle in the IDE, verifies it with the tool's own check, and opens a new chat with the bundle as its first context. Draft handoff writes a propose-only GhostHandoff pack from repo facts and shows the draft in chat; nothing is committed, sent, or changed.

The find panel gains an Indexed mode: the real GhostIndex FTS5 index over the whole workspace, built and searched by the tool itself, returning its own token-budgeted sliced excerpts that open at the hit.
